title: Can i get in trouble for this?
author: nonsalantan
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/iep6dso1oh0i1.png

I'm making a game, as you can see, that features a crossover of anime characters. However, the game will be completely free-to-play, and I won't be making any money from it whatsoever. What are the chances of me running into copyright issues because of this?

comments.author: Similar_Guide4193
comments.body:
Yes, I'd consider this fan art which is not excluded from copyright law. And these companies are more picky about games as fan art then drawing as fan art.

Best bet is to make them a parody of the characters. If you can somehow integrate the parody with the crossover as a story element of your game it might work.

comments.author: Vivid-Snow-2089
comments.body:
you are violating the copyright of the rightsholders of those IPs there is no question about it

any popularity / visibility / success raises the chances that they will decide to DMCA you

comments.author: zircher
comments.body: Yeah, you're looking at an almost 100% change of getting a taking down request, especially with the names included.  u/Similar_Guide4193 has the right idea, change from a direct rip off to a parody where the look and names are slightly different.

comments.author: Sorrytokeepyouwaitin
comments.body: If you get any eyes on it the IP holders will want to sue you to scoop it up for themselves to use. Best to just keep it to yourself

comments.author: Ill-Past4609
comments.body: Ngl looks clean what did you use to make these ? Why not just do what other people do and change the names 🤣

comments.author: Level3Super
comments.body: Complete the then add these as skins

comments.author: Sakcrel
comments.body: I would not worry about it, there is a shiton of fan games around from companies like Nintendo and it is fine as long you don't charge money.

comments.author: TheXIIILightning
comments.body:
This is the type of project where you ["Shut the fuck up"](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hqwP6uuYOWo) until its done and available for download.

You'll no doubt get a takedown notice the moment you talk about it online and it gets any visibility.

comments.author: ConsultioGames
comments.body: doesn't it qualify as like.. "parody" if you named them Fluffy, Doku etc.?

comments.author: RiaRio
comments.body: Shonen Jump is extremely aggressive on copyright infringement and you have most of their IPs right here.
